Package org.thewhitemage13.service

Class InventoryStatisticService

java.lang.Object
org.thewhitemage13.service.InventoryStatisticService
All Implemented Interfaces:
InventoryStatisticServiceInterface
@Transactional @Service public class InventoryStatisticService extends Object implements InventoryStatisticServiceInterface
Service class for managing InventoryStatistic entities.

This class provides methods for creating, retrieving, and deleting inventory statistics. It also allows fetching statistics filtered by message.

Version:
1.0.0
Author:
Mukhammed Lolo

  • Method Details

    • createInventoryStatistic

      public void createInventoryStatistic(InventoryStatistic inventoryStatistic, org.thewhitemage13.ProductCreateEvent productCreateEvent)
      Creates a new inventory statistic using the information from the provided ProductCreateEvent.

      This method sets the current date, product name, product ID, and quantity from the event, and then persists the new statistic to the database.

      Specified by:
      createInventoryStatistic in interface InventoryStatisticServiceInterface
      Parameters:
      inventoryStatistic - the InventoryStatistic entity to be created
      productCreateEvent - the ProductCreateEvent containing the details for the new statistic

    • getAllInventoryStatisticsByMessage

      public List<InventoryStatistic> getAllInventoryStatisticsByMessage(String message)
      Retrieves all InventoryStatistic entities that match the specified message.

      If no statistics are found for the given message, a StatisticsNotFoundException is thrown.

      Specified by:
      getAllInventoryStatisticsByMessage in interface InventoryStatisticServiceInterface
      Parameters:
      message - the message to filter the inventory statistics
      Returns:
      a list of InventoryStatistic matching the specified message
      Throws:
      StatisticsNotFoundException - if no statistics are found with the given message
